summary: Eva Live Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a Letter of Intent to acquire Psquared Inc. The target has generated over $50 million in revenue over four years on a profitable basis. Terms such as price per share, premium, and consideration are not disclosed. The CEO of Eva Live, David Boulette, signed the filing. Psquared's founder Jean-Sebastien Paul is expected to continue leading the subsidiary. No advisors or break fees are named. The deal is structured as a wholly owned subsidiary integration. No regulatory clock or closing date is provided. Watch for definitive agreement and material terms.
